name: Offline browser-based weights harness for writers

mentions.name: Offline browser-based weights harness for writers
mentions.description: An offline LLM weights harness that runs in the browser and is designed for non-technical people, especially writers. It enforces very few paradigms, is built to work long-term and adapt as new model weights are released, and lets users view and edit agent config files within the UI. It focuses on general text manipulation (writing) rather than coding.
mentions.problem: Existing offline LLM harnesses are optimized toward coding rather than general text manipulation (writing), and few projects take an approach suited to non-technical writers.
mentions.source_excerpt:
i am working on an offline weights harness for non-technical people, writers mainly. it's designed to work forever but also be adaptable as more weights get released etc.

it enforces very few paradigms, runs in the browser, and allows users to view and edit agent config files within the UI.
